translations.idiomatic: Eastern Capital regent Prince Bo Youwen marched against him without asking first. When the army reached Yanling, the emperor said, "Cunyan is already terrified—send troops at him and he'll bolt.

sentences.zh: 」馳使召還。

translations.literal: 」He dispatched fast messengers to recall them.
translations.idiomatic: 」He sent riders to call them back.

sentences.zh: 甲子，授存儼權知蔡州事。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Cunyan was appointed acting administrator of Caizhou affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Cunyan was made acting prefect of Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，周德威自臨清攻貝州，拔夏津、高唐；

translations.literal: On yichou, Zhou Dewei attacked Bei Prefecture from Linqing and captured Xiajin and Gaotang;
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhou Dewei struck Bei Prefecture from Linqing, taking Xiajin and Gaotang;

sentences.zh: 攻博州，拔東武、朝城。

translations.literal: He attacked Bo Prefecture and captured Dongwu and Chaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: He took Bo Prefecture, capturing Dongwu and Chaocheng.

sentences.zh: 攻澶州，刺史張可臻棄城走，帝斬之。

translations.literal: He attacked Chan Prefecture; prefect Zhang Kezhen abandoned the city and fled; the emperor had him executed.
translations.idiomatic: At Chan Prefecture, prefect Zhang Kezhen fled; the emperor had him beheaded.

sentences.zh: 德威進攻黎陽，拔臨河、淇門；

translations.literal: Dewei pressed the attack on Liyang and captured Linhe and Qimen;
translations.idiomatic: Dewei pushed into Liyang, taking Linhe and Qimen;

sentences.zh: 逼衛州，掠新鄉、共城。

translations.literal: He pressed Wei Prefecture and raided Xinxiang and Gongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: He threatened Weizhou and raided Xinxiang and Gongcheng.

sentences.zh: 庚午，帝帥親軍屯白司馬阪以備之。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the emperor personally led his guard army to encamp at White Sima Slope to guard against him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the emperor moved his personal army to White Sima Slope to block him.

sentences.zh: 盧龍、義昌節度使兼中書令燕王守光既克滄州，自謂得天助，淫虐滋甚。

translations.literal: Liu Shouguang, Prince of Yan, military governor of Lulong and Yichang and concurrent grand councilor, having taken Cang Prefecture, considered himself Heaven-aided and grew ever more licentious and cruel.
translations.idiomatic: Having taken Cangzhou, Liu Shouguang—the Prince of Yan, governor of Lulong and Yichang—decided Heaven was on his side and turned ever more brutal and debauched.

sentences.zh: 每刑人，必置諸鐵籠，以火逼之；

translations.literal: Whenever he punished someone, he always placed them in an iron cage and drove them with fire;
translations.idiomatic: For every execution he locked the victim in an iron cage and roasted them with fire;

sentences.zh: 又為鐵刷刷人面。

translations.literal: He also made an iron brush to scour people's faces.
translations.idiomatic: he scraped faces with an iron brush.

sentences.zh: 聞梁兵敗於柏鄉，使人謂趙王鎔及王處直曰：「聞二鎮與晉王破梁兵，舉軍南下，僕亦有精騎三萬，欲自將之為諸公啟行。

translations.literal: Hearing that the Liang army had been defeated at Baixiang, he sent men to tell Zhao prince Rong and Wang Chuzhi, "I hear the two garrisons with the Prince of Jin have broken the Liang army and are leading their whole force south; I too have thirty thousand elite horsemen and wish to lead them personally to open the way for you lords.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard of the Liang defeat at Baixiang, he messaged Zhao prince Rong and Wang Chuzhi: "I hear you and the Prince of Jin smashed the Liang army and are marching south. I have thirty thousand elite cavalry and would lead them myself to clear your path.

sentences.zh: 然四鎮連兵，必有盟主，僕若至彼，何以處之？

translations.literal: Yet when four garrisons join forces there must be a covenant leader—if I arrive there, how am I to be placed?
translations.idiomatic: But four armies together need a leader. When I arrive, where do I stand?

sentences.zh: 」鎔患之，遣使告於晉王，晉王笑曰：「趙人告急，守光不能出一卒以救之；

translations.literal: " Rong was alarmed and sent envoys to the Prince of Jin; the prince laughed and said, "When Zhao cried for help, Shouguang would not send a single soldier;
translations.idiomatic: " Alarmed, Rong sent word to the Prince of Jin, who laughed: "When Zhao pleaded for help, Shouguang would not send a single man;

sentences.zh: 及吾成功，乃復欲以兵威離間二鎮，愚莫甚焉！

translations.literal: Now that I have succeeded, he again wants to use military might to drive a wedge between the two circuits—nothing could be more foolish!
translations.idiomatic: Now that we've won, he wants to use force to split the two circuits—nothing could be more foolish!

sentences.zh: 」諸將曰：「雲、代與燕接境，彼若擾我城戍，動搖人情，吾千里出征，緩急難應，此亦腹心之患也。

translations.literal: " The generals said, "Yun and Dai border Yan; if they harass our garrisons and shake morale, we are a thousand li from home and cannot respond quickly—that too is a threat at our vitals.
translations.idiomatic: " The generals said, "Yun and Dai border Yan; if they raid our posts and shake morale, we're a thousand li from home and can't respond in time—that's a threat to our rear as well.

sentences.zh: 不若先取守光，然後可以專意南討。

translations.literal: Better to take Shouguang first, then we can turn south with a single mind.
translations.idiomatic: Better to take Shouguang first, then we can focus on the south.

sentences.zh: 」王曰：「善！

translations.literal: " The prince said, "Good!
translations.idiomatic: " The prince said, "Good!

sentences.zh: 」會楊師厚自磁、相引兵救邢、魏，壬申，晉解圍去；

translations.literal: " At that time Yang Shihou led troops from Ci and Xiang to relieve Xing and Wei; on the day renshen, Jin lifted the siege and withdrew;
translations.idiomatic: " Just then Yang Shihou marched from Ci and Xiang to relieve Xing and Wei; on renshen Jin lifted the siege and withdrew;

sentences.zh: 師厚追之，逾漳水而還，邢州圍亦解。

translations.literal: Shihou pursued them, crossed the Zhang River, and returned; the siege of Xingzhou was also lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Shihou pursued, crossed the Zhang River, and turned back; the siege of Xingzhou was lifted as well.

sentences.zh: 師厚留屯魏州。

translations.literal: Shihou remained encamped at Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shihou stayed encamped at Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 趙王鎔自來謁晉王於趙州，大犒將士，自是遣其養子德明將三十七都常從晉王征討。

translations.literal: King Rong of Zhao came in person to visit the Prince of Jin at Zhaozhou and feasted the officers generously; thereafter he sent his adopted son Deming to lead thirty-seven companies in constant attendance on the prince's campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Rong of Zhao came in person to Zhaozhou to pay his respects and feasted the army lavishly; thereafter he sent his adopted son Deming with thirty-seven companies to follow the prince on campaign.

sentences.zh: 德明本姓張，名文禮，燕人也。

translations.literal: Deming was originally surnamed Zhang, named Wenli, and was a native of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Deming had originally been surnamed Zhang, named Wenli, and was from Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，晉王發趙州，歸晉陽，留周德威等將三千人戍趙州。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the Prince of Jin set out from Zhaozhou and returned to Jinyang, leaving Zhou Dewei and others with three thousand men to garrison Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Prince of Jin left Zhaozhou for Jinyang, leaving Zhou Dewei and three thousand men to garrison Zhaozhou.
